jasoos.title: Jasoos Golgappa
jasoos.pitch: Jasoos Golgappa, a round, proud village detective who is sure of every wrong answer, and Chameli, the calm goat who quietly solves each case for him

cast.name: village detective Jasoos Golgappa
cast.look: short, round, cheerful man of about 45 with a thick curled black moustache and big round glasses, wearing an oversized mustard-brown trench coat over a white kurta, a bright red woollen muffler and a brown felt hat one size too small; always carries a large magnifying glass tied to a bamboo stick

cast.name: goat Chameli
cast.look: small white goat with one black ear, half-closed unimpressed eyes, a tiny brass bell on a blue thread collar and a marigold tucked behind the black ear

jasoos.rules: Every episode is one small village mystery. Golgappa announces a grand, wrong theory and accuses the wrong suspect; Chameli notices the real clue in the background (the viewer sees it before he does) and nudges him to the answer; he proudly takes the credit and she gives the camera one tired look in the last scene. Golgappa's lines are short and boastful; Chameli only ever says one dry word or a bleat.
